product.name: Work Engine
journeys: An operator creates a durable Project and submits bounded software Work.
The operator attaches to a Cloudflare Project workspace through Herdr remote SSH.
A bounded OMP Project Manager Session starts a distinct OMP worker Session through scoped Work Engine tools.
The worker produces a real patch, verification Evidence, and a revision-bound Proposal.
An operator approval and scoped Merge Grant permit one atomic Merge into Canonical Project State.
The accepted result survives Container loss while any retry receives a new Session identity.
constraints: The Project, not an agent, harness, terminal, container, database projection, or memory system, is the durable semantic authority.
The first deployed journey is hosted on Cloudflare products and uses a real OMP 17.2.3 worker.
Herdr is the operator and terminal surface; tracer 0001 has no custom web frontend.
All external and persistent representations are decoded at runtime with Effect Schema.
The pure kernel has no runtime, platform, clock, random, filesystem, process, network, or model dependency.
Deployment, credentials, external repository mutation, and other public effects require explicit operator authority.
Workgraph is design prior art only until its license or transfer authority is resolved.
Repository founding copies are imported verbatim from the two SHA-256-bound source documents named in design-specs/0001-cloud-herdr-omp-tracer.md.

Bun CLI and local tooling integration; excluded from Worker closures.
Effect-specific typed diagnostics and language-service checks.
Canonical formatter for source, configuration, and documentation.
Fast syntax, architecture, correctness, and portability policy.
Repository-reviewed Effect v4 syntax and scope policy; type-aware Effect checks remain with effect-tsgo.
Singular typed Cloudflare infrastructure graph in TypeScript and Effect.
Cloudflare development, generated binding types, Container instance discovery, and authenticated SSH proxy.
Command/query edge and deployed composition root.
Pinned declarations for Workers, Durable Objects, R2, Queues, Workflows, Containers, and bindings.
One serialized Project authority with transactional SQLite storage.
Disposable full-Linux Project workspace hosting Herdr and OMP processes.
Account-authenticated OpenSSH ProxyCommand used by Herdr remote attach.
Content-addressed artifacts, Evidence, Handoffs, workspace manifests, and Session exports.
Derived cross-Project discovery and query index; never Project authority.
Operator identity and API access policy in front of Work Engine endpoints.
Scoped model egress, usage observation, limits, and provider routing without exposing provider credentials to OMP.
Cloudflare-hosted @cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b model for the OMP tracer through the trusted loopback proxy; function-calling compatibility is a required real-binary gate.
Structured operational evidence for API, Project authority, and Container control paths.
Derived transition, latency, attempt, and resource measurements.
Bounded reconciliation of expired workspace leases and interrupted Sessions.
Existing terminal workspace, remote SSH attach, OMP lifecycle, and agent-session operator surface.
Primary Project Manager and worker harness with native Herdr integration.
Isolated worktrees, exact diffs, and local fixture custody; no external push in tracer 0001.
Cloudflare runtime integration tests where Bun's runner cannot execute in workerd.
Durable Object, binding, and Worker integration tests in the Workers runtime.
Property tests for transition, idempotency, revision, retry, and derivation laws.
Maintained RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme implementation for persistent structured digests.
Conventional commit-message gate in the native Git hook path.
Pinned conventional-commit rule preset consumed by commitlint.
Durable supervision, bounded retries, waits, and recovery for each bounded Session attempt.
At-least-once delivery of accepted Project effect requests to Session Workflows, made idempotent by stable effect identity.
Reopen for per-Session isolation of arbitrary untrusted repositories; the first fixture is trusted.
Potential channel-first Project Manager adapter through Work Engine MCP; a Flue Cloudflare agent is not an SSH process.
Its server owns a competing orchestration event log and has no OMP or external backend plugin boundary; direct reuse violates single authority.
A custom frontend adds no value to tracer 0001 because Herdr is the approved interface.
No browser application is built in tracer 0001.
No frontend build exists, so adding another toolchain is unjustified.
No custom visual surface exists in tracer 0001.
Memory is advisory and needs a separate redaction, provenance, replacement, and bounded-recall tracer.
Private beta and not required for Project correctness.
Reopen when a selected Work kind requires browser interaction.
No runtime-generated isolate is required by the first fixed Work Process.
Work Engine keeps its harness seam independent and uses OMP first.
The stable Containers path satisfies the first full-Linux need.
Retrieval is not required before a memory/search Work journey exists.
No semantic retrieval index is required by tracer 0001.
No external relational database is selected.
Wrangler and Alchemy provide the first deployment path without a beta CI dependency.
R2 supplies the required stable artifact storage path.
No eventually consistent cache is needed for canonical or derived first-tracer state.

owns: D1, R2, Queue, and Workflow adapters

batches.done_when: The active approved tracer contract is frozen, prior contracts retain explicit historical status, and founding claims remain bound to exact source hashes.
Every selected technology, owner, batch, deviation, artifact, and verification command has one validated manifest entry.
The two founding documents are copied byte-for-byte and SOURCES.json verifies their frozen SHA-256 values.
Exact dependencies install; generated configuration and source/license audits pass; hooks enforce path ownership; canonical deterministic commands resolve.

Decoded commands drive accepted and rejected pure transitions; ProjectAuthority, ArtifactStore, and SessionHost contracts are exported and contract-tested; laws cover authority, idempotency, revision safety, retry identity, Gate derivation, and provenance.

The Project Durable Object, transactional outbox, R2 ordering, D1 projection, deterministic Workflow identity, Queue, Session Workflow, auth/query Grants, attach-resolution lifecycle, Container lease, compatibility date/flags, Cron reconciliation, and Worker composition root satisfy the frozen protocol/runtime contracts.

The digest-pinned Container starts pinned Herdr/OMP without resume, isolates every Session UID from sibling credentials and the Herdr socket, idempotently starts one process, freezes and checks one candidate snapshot, persists Workspace/Handoff manifests, reports typed lifecycle observations, and treats process loss as Session interruption.

The work CLI and MCP roots use only the frozen protocol schemas, bind actor identity, honor the fixed JSON/exit-code contract, obtain a fresh attach resolution, verify plain SSH, and attach Herdr through the documented Cloudflare proxy.
The exact fixture, negative controls, evidence bundle, local preflight, and deployed Cloudflare tracer satisfy every acceptance step and falsifier in design-specs/0001-cloud-herdr-omp-tracer.md.

verification.proves: The committed dependency graph installs deterministically without package lifecycle code.
Authored files match the selected Oxfmt representation.
Syntax, architecture, Effect scope, and portability rules hold with no warnings or stale suppressions.
Founding-source hashes match, every copied/adapted source has resolved license provenance, and Workgraph source remains absent.
TypeScript 7 and Effect diagnostics accept every package boundary.
Kernel examples and properties enforce transition, authority, idempotency, revision, retry, and derivation contracts.
Worker, Durable Object, D1, R2, Queue, Workflow, Container lease, and reconciliation adapters uphold the runtime contract under workerd.
The real pinned Herdr/OMP image satisfies lifecycle, worktree, Evidence, interruption, and capability boundaries.
The CLI, MCP server, Container image context, and Worker closure build without forbidden runtime imports.
A real local OMP fixture journey reaches Proposal, rejects unauthorized Merge, then accepts operator-authorized Merge.
A deployed Cloudflare preview supports real Container SSH, Herdr remote attach, OMP execution, durable Evidence, governed Merge, and Container-loss recovery.
Exactly fmt:check, lint, audit:sources, typecheck, test:kernel, test:cloudflare, test:session-host, and build compose through one deterministic command; acceptance runs are excluded.

deviations.reason: Cloudflare Container filesystem state is disposable; Workspace continuity is represented by content-addressed R2 manifests and explicit Handoffs, then rematerialized per Session.
